'''Ice Station Beta''' was an Imperial Robotics Construction Facility on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Anteevy/Legends|Anteevy]].

==History==
The station refined [[Phrik/Legends|Phrik]] and was responsible for the construction of specially-modified cold-weather [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]]&mdash;nicknamed among the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] as "snow [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]". These walkers, designed with heat circulation systems, de-icing controls, and energy efficient environmental controls, were employed with great success during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

It may also have been where phase two of the [[Dark Trooper Project]] was to proceed. Newly defected Imperial officer [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] indicated this as the second target the Rebel Alliance needed to hit in order to terminate the project.

The base was then [[Mission to Anteevy|infiltrated]] by Rebel agent [[Kyle Katarn]] and destroyed by placing [[sequencer charge]]s throughout certain [[exchange coupling]] ports. Both [[Phase I Dark Trooper|Phase I]] and [[Phase II Dark Trooper/Legends|Phase II]] Dark Troopers were deployed to defend the inner segments of the facility.
